findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_glossary, get_term, get_obligation, get_pattern, get_template, search_bok, list_controls, get_control · Private data: list_templates, get_template, get_control · Public sink: search_bok · Destructive: get_obligations, get_pattern, list_controls, get_control.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_glossary, get_term, get_obligation, get_pattern, get_template, search_bok, list_controls, get_control · Private data: list_templates, get_template, get_control · Public sink: search_bok · Destructive: get_obligations, get_pattern, list_controls, get_control

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
